contents: Published src tree, Cargo manifest, LICENSE and upstream .cargo_vcs_info.json; upstream examples, benches, README, CHANGELOG and lockfile excluded. Manifest readme field disabled and [[example]]/[[bench]] targets removed accordingly.

patches.purpose: Per-request override of the HEADERS frame priority fields (dependency, weight, exclusive flag), taken from the request extensions before they are cleared. Backport of upstream commits 18fcb36, d012d10, 9958a76 and 6e46310 (unreleased on crates.io); API name and semantics match upstream so the override can be dropped once a release contains them. Frame encoding, flags and the connection default are unchanged.

regressions: ../../src/emulation/tests.rs (HTTP/2 golden frames: SETTINGS, WINDOW_UPDATE, HEADERS weight and header order)
refreshRequirement: Reverify a new upstream crate checksum; drop this override when a released http2 contains ext::HeadersPriority, then rerun the HTTP/2 golden and header-identity regressions.
